description: FULL BODY. A Malaysian male in his late 30s with a professional, authoritative posture. He is wearing a crisp, formal Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) dark blue uniform, complete with silver badges, name tag, and a peaked police cap. He has short, neat black hair and a serious expression, standing in a full-length pose.

FULL BODY. A Malaysian male in his mid-20s representing a young professional. He has a clean-cut appearance with short black hair and is wearing a casual festive-themed short-sleeve red batik shirt with dark chinos and casual loafers. He is shown from head to toe with an average build.

FULL BODY. A featureless, anonymous human silhouette rendered in a semi-transparent glitch effect. The figure is entirely void of facial features or skin details, appearing as a dark, shadowy entity. It wears a non-descript hooded sweatshirt and long trousers, with a faint digital data-stream texture flowing through the silhouette.
